plan.title: Mandatory T&C notice after vendor bid

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow specified by the case.
Set the event type to RFQ.
Provide the required event title before publishing.
Apply an RFQ template so the pricing sheet and Terms and Conditions controls are available.

args.goal: On the RFQ create screen, add the product CYLINDER, choose CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB so Product Variant shows Default Variant, set Quantity Requested to 10, select Plant Name (LOC-0001) for Delivery location, open Terms and Conditions, mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory, and return to the create screen showing the configured event.

steps.note: Perform the case-specific product, quantity, location, and mandatory T&C configuration that has no dedicated catalog step.

Commit a valid event schedule required for publishing.
Invite one available QA vendor so the event can receive a bid.
Confirm the event reached its published project page.
Have the invited QA vendor submit a bid so the post-bid event page can be checked.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted and submitted.

args.text: Vendors who have placed the bid, have accepted the Terms and Conditions.

steps.note: Verify the mandatory T&C notice appears on the event page after the vendor bids.
